sql.if: AND f.uploaded_at >= #{uploadDate} AND f.uploaded_at < DATE_ADD(#{uploadDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_files f INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = f.user_id WHERE u.username = #{username}

SELECT f.file_id as fileId, f.file_name as fileName, f.file_save_name as fileSaveName, f.file_size as fileSize, DATE_FORMAT(f.uploaded_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS fileUploadDate, DATE_FORMAT(f.uploaded_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AS cursorDate FROM user_files f INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = f.user_id WHERE u.username = #{username}
ORDER BY f.uploaded_at DESC, f.file_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT f.file_id as fileId, f.file_name as fileName, f.file_save_name as fileSaveName, f.file_size as fileSize, DATE_FORMAT(f.uploaded_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS fileUploadDate, DATE_FORMAT(f.uploaded_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AS cursorDate FROM user_files f INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = f.user_id WHERE u.username = #{username}
AND (f.uploaded_at < STR_TO_DATE(#{cursorDate}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') OR (f.uploaded_at = STR_TO_DATE(#{cursorDate}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AND f.file_id < #{cursorId})) ORDER BY f.uploaded_at DESC, f.file_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT f.file_id as fileId, f.file_name as fileName, f.file_save_name as fileSaveName, f.file_size as fileSize, DATE_FORMAT(f.uploaded_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS fileUploadDate, DATE_FORMAT(f.uploaded_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AS cursorDate FROM user_files f INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = f.user_id WHERE u.username = #{username}
AND (f.uploaded_at > STR_TO_DATE(#{cursorDate}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') OR (f.uploaded_at = STR_TO_DATE(#{cursorDate}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AND f.file_id > #{cursorId})) ORDER BY f.uploaded_at ASC, f.file_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_files (Id, file_name, file_save_name, file_dir, file_size, uploaded_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{file_name}, #{file_save_name}, #{fileDir}, #{fileSize}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT file_id as fileId, file_dir as fileDir FROM user_files WHERE uploaded_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 14 DAY)
